remarks: Sun-filled end-unit townhouse in sought-after River's Edge! This bright and stylish home offers a flexible layout with an open floor plan, high ceilings, and beautiful natural light throughout. Enjoy a sleek eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and sliders to a private deck - perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation.  Upstairs, you'll find a spacious primary suite, a comfortable second bedroom, and a versatile loft that can serve as a third bedroom, office, or entertainment room.  Residents have access to a resort-style pool, modern fitness center, and scenic walking paths along the river. Conveniently located near the train, restaurants, cinema, and local shops, everything you need just minutes away.  This is modern living with comfort, light, and lifestyle all in one place!
